title: Building Amount Rated at FloodGuard Renewal
content:
Underwriting bulletin — FloodGuard Private Flood Policy renewal offers.

At the renewal offer of a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy, the building premium is rated on an amount chosen from three records on file on the renewal offer date: the building limit, the building replacement cost, and the building limit increase recorded on the policy (the most recently requested building limit increase, with the date it attaches and the increased limit it records).

## Paragraphs

1. When the building limit on file exceeds the building replacement cost on file, the building premium is rated on the replacement cost instead of the limit.
2. When the limit does not exceed the replacement cost and a building limit increase recorded on the policy attaches after the renewal offer date and no later than the expiration date, the building premium is rated on the increased limit that increase records.
3. In every other case the building premium is rated on the building limit on file.

## Decision table

| Building limit on file compared with replacement cost on file | Building limit increase attaching after the renewal offer date and no later than the expiration date | Amount rated |
|---|---|---|
| Limit above replacement cost | Present or absent | Building replacement cost on file |
| Limit equal to or below replacement cost | Present | Increased limit recorded by that increase |
| Limit equal to or below replacement cost | Absent, or attaching on or before the renewal offer date, or after the expiration date | Building limit on file |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

Hypothetical policy: renewal offer date 2 April, expiration date 1 June of the same year.

- Building limit 300,000 and replacement cost 300,000: the limit does not exceed the replacement cost, so paragraph 1 does not apply; with no increase attaching in the window, the amount rated is the limit, 300,000.
- Building limit 320,000 and replacement cost 300,000: the limit exceeds the replacement cost, so the amount rated is 300,000, whatever increase is recorded.
- Building limit 250,000, replacement cost 300,000, an increase to 280,000 attaching on 2 April: attaching on the renewal offer date is not after it, so the amount rated is the limit, 250,000.
- Same policy, the increase to 280,000 attaching on 1 June: attaching on the expiration date is no later than it, so the amount rated is 280,000.
- Same policy, the increase attaching on 3 April: after the renewal offer date and before expiration, so the amount rated is 280,000.
